critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 900 lines — split threshold breached; move cohort/vocational/bulk into routers/ subpackage.
CORS middleware still registered AFTER include_router (unchanged from iter 2).
/api/vocational uses substring match for stream (`stream.lower() in s.lower() or vice-versa`) — 'PC' would match 'Science (PCM)' and 'Science (PCB)' both; consider exact-tag match.
Bulk endpoint accepts admin but sets school='' for admin — creates students with school_name=None; if desired, allow admin to pass explicit school_name in payload.
Bulk endpoint returns temp_password in plaintext (expected for onboarding) but has no rate limit; large payloads could tie up event loop — consider capping students list length (e.g., 500).
CohortComparison fetches /cohort/:id and silently returns null on error — should show a user-visible message if a counselor loads a stale/forbidden result.
_percentile treats ties as 'below only if strictly less' — students tied at top with peers get lower percentile than expected; using midrank would be fairer.
